mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.attempts ( id, student_id, quiz_id, quiz_release_id, score, start_time, due_time, submitted_time, time_spent_seconds, status, error_reason, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{studentId}, #{quizId}, #{quizReleaseId}, #{score}, #{startTime}, #{dueTime}, #{submittedTime}, #{timeSpentSeconds}, #{status, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.attempt.app.domain.Attempt$AttemptStatus, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{errorReason}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.attempts SET student_id = #{studentId}, quiz_id = #{quizId}, quiz_release_id = #{quizReleaseId}, score = #{score}, start_time = #{startTime}, due_time = #{dueTime}, submitted_time = #{submittedTime}, time_spent_seconds = #{timeSpentSeconds}, status = #{status, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.attempt.app.domain.Attempt$AttemptStatus, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, error_reason = #{errorReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id, quiz_id, quiz_release_id, score, start_time, due_time, submitted_time, time_spent_seconds, status, error_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.attempts WHERE id = #{attemptId}
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.attempts SET status = #{status, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.attempt.app.domain.Attempt$AttemptStatus, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, score = #{score}, error_reason = #{errorReason}, submitted_time = #{submittedTime}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND status = 'STARTED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id, quiz_id, quiz_release_id, score, start_time, due_time, submitted_time, time_spent_seconds, status, error_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.attempts WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND quiz_id = #{quizId} AND status = 'STARTED' ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1
